text: Hi, Professor. Thanks for seeing me. Of course, what can I do for you? I wanted to ask if you would be available and willing to advise me on my thesis. What is your thesis proposal on? I would like to do a case study on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns that use celebrity endorsements. That’s an interesting topic. Have you done any preliminary research on it? Yeah, I’ve read a few articles and studies on the topic already. But I’m having trouble finding good data sources to use for my case study. Yeah, that can be tough. You might have better luck looking at secondary data sources like surveys or data from social media platforms. But yes, I think I can advise you on this kind of project. Thank you, Professor!
